findings.F1: The book barely trades. Only 4.8 % of the coin-bars in folds B and C are inside the choppy agitated profile. The book's mean daily return is within ±0.0002 in 11 of 12 windows, while holding the coins earned between -0.0056 and +0.0137 a day. Its +0.94 % unusual move per case (t 1.64) rests on a few dozen grid cases a fold (16–17 per depth tercile when the profile is active).
findings.F2: The 30-day fall depth in usual moves is not graded across all bars (1,352 non-overlapping 5-day cases). The second-deepest quintile is followed by -2.44 % excess (day-pooled t -2.61, 120 days), but the deepest only by -0.94 % (t -0.61, 91 days). The fourth quintile, a moderate rise, is followed by +2.36 % (t 2.21). The pattern turns over rather than deepening with the fall.
findings.F3: The brief's volume split leans the brief's way but cannot be told from chance. Falls on the quietest third of 10-day/60-day volume are followed by -2.85 % excess over 5 days (t -1.68, 60 days), and falls on the heaviest third by -1.41 % (t -0.72, 61 days). Within falling-trend falls the figures are -2.59 % (t -1.15) for quiet and -0.13 % (t -0.05) for heavy.
findings.F4: Choppy-trend falls are followed by declines in every volume tercile: -2.90 % (t -1.70), -7.95 % (t -1.96) and -4.46 % (t -2.00). Each holds only 23–29 cases on 18–23 days, so no tercile stands out beyond the many cuts examined.
findings.F5: After a sharp down day (1.5 or more of its usual daily move), the next day's excess return is +1.90 % when the day's volume was in the heavier half (t 2.33, 76 days), against +0.46 % in the lighter half (t 0.82, 91 days). This is a one-day rebound of the kind the profile map already holds many times on the long side (falling agitated and agitated rebounds).
findings.F6: Weekday effects do not survive pooling cases by day. Saturday's next-day excess is +0.41 % (t 1.59) and Thursday's is -0.48 % (t -1.22). Saturday reaches t 2.93 only in fold B's windows (+0.93 %) and is -0.17 % (t -0.41) in fold C.

no_ideas: Across about fifteen angles (fall depth by quintile, volume terciles, trend × volume, depth × volume, fold halves, sharp down days by volume and trend, weekdays), the theme's effect is weak or not graded (F2, F3, F4), and nothing stands out enough beyond chance for that many looks. The one pattern near the bar (F5, t 2.33) repeats the one-day long rebounds the profile map already holds.
